Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner compared only the month and day of the directors’ birthdays (04-04 vs. 05-22) and ignored the years, concluding Andrew Lau (born 1960-04-04) was “born first” over Homi Wadia (born 1911-05-22). Chronologically, 1911 precedes 1960, so Homi Wadia was born earlier, making Hanuman Patal Vijay the correct film.
